The plate is about 350 px across, and if it is roughly a 26 cm dinner plate, that is about 13 px per cm.

The meat is about 130 px wide and 90 px tall, which is roughly 10 cm by 7 cm. It looks like a thin steak or piece of meat, maybe 1.5 cm thick. That gives about 70 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 100 cm³, or around 100 g. A cooked cut like this runs roughly 200 kcal per 100 g, so I'd put it at about 100 g and 220 kcal.

There are about 7 roasted potato pieces, each about 3 cm across. At roughly 15 g each that is about 105 g. Roast potatoes are about 150 kcal per 100 g, so about 160 kcal.

Total: about 205 g and about 380 kcal.
